nodes.description: A patent publication titled "Social medical network for diagnosis assistance" describing a method and system for assisting medical diagnosis by exploiting similarity between new medical cases and existing cases and experts in a common embedding space.

nodes.entity_id: Social Medical Network For Diagnosis Assistance
nodes.description: The title of patent US9589231B2, referring to a network-based approach for assisting diagnosis through similarity matching of medical cases and experts.
nodes.id: Social Medical Network For Diagnosis Assistance

nodes.description: A method that receives a query request including a new medical case, embeds the new case in an embedding space containing existing medical cases and experts, allows selection between query-for-cases and query-for-experts, and returns subsets of cases or experts based on computed similarity.

A multidimensional space in which new medical cases, existing medical cases, and experts are embedded as representations.<SEP>A common multidimensional space in which new medical cases, existing medical cases, and experts are embedded so that similarity between their representations can be computed.

A medical case submitted by a requester for which a diagnosis is sought, embedded in an embedding space.<SEP>A medical case submitted by a requester as part of a query, comprising a plurality of records relating to a specific patient, which is embedded in the embedding space.

A set of previously known medical cases embedded in the embedding space, used for similarity comparison.<SEP>A set of previously stored medical cases that are embedded in the embedding space and used as candidates for similarity-based retrieval in a query-for-cases.

A set of experts embedded in the embedding space who can be queried and to whom a new case may be communicated for diagnosis.<SEP>A set of medical experts embedded in the embedding space based on information such as their profile, coded medical procedures performed, authored articles, and linked stored medical cases, who may be selected to formulate a diagnosis.

A user who submits a query request including a new medical case and selects from a plurality of query types.<SEP>A user who submits a query request including a new medical case and selects from available query types.

A query type that returns a subset of existing cases based on computed similarity between the embedded new case and embedded existing cases.<SEP>A query type in which a subset of existing medical cases is returned based on computed similarity between the embedded new case and the embedded existing cases.

A query type that returns a subset of experts based on computed similarity between the embedded new case and embedded experts.<SEP>A query type in which a subset of experts is returned based on computed similarity between the embedded new case and the embedded experts.

A computed cost for a query, where the cost for a query-for-experts differs from the cost for a query-for-cases.<SEP>A computed cost for a query, where the cost for a query-for-experts differs from and is higher than the cost for a query-for-cases, encouraging requesters to try query-by-cases first.
A structured set of medical concepts joined by links, each concept corresponding to a dimension in the multidimensional representation, used as the basis for embedding medical cases and experts.
A medical ontology on which the medical ontology used for embedding is based.

A representation of a medical case or expert generated in the embedding space.<SEP>A computed representation of a medical case based on the medical ontology, used for embedding cases and experts in the embedding space.
A matrix applied to the multidimensional representation of the new case that accounts for relationships between concepts in the ontology when computing the similarity measure.

The determination sought for a new medical case, which an expert may attempt to provide.<SEP>The medical determination that a selected expert attempts to formulate for a new case provided via a query-for-experts.
A payment made to an expert for formulating a diagnosis when a query-for-experts is selected.
A database from which documents are returned based on computed similarity between the embedded new case and embedded documents when a query-for-cases is selected.
A system comprising memory storing instructions for performing the diagnosis assistance method and a processor in communication with the memory for executing the instructions.
A product comprising a non-transitory recording medium storing instructions that, when executed on a computer, cause the computer to perform the diagnosis assistance method.
A processor that performs at least one of the embedding, providing, returning subsets of cases or experts, and computing the query cost.

A plurality of records relating to a specific patient that make up the new medical case, including laboratory test results, images, symptom descriptions, patient monitor results, diagnoses, prescribed medications and treatments.
A plurality of selectable query types including a query-for-cases and a query-for-experts.
A processor in communication with memory that executes stored instructions.
Memory that stores instructions for performing the query and diagnosis assistance operations.
A system comprising memory and a processor that provides diagnosis assistance by handling queries for cases and experts.
A network comprising a diagnosis assistance system and a set of user devices linking requesters and experts with the system.
A set of devices for linking requesters and experts with the diagnosis assistance system.

edges.description: The patent publication US9589231B2 describes a method for diagnosis assistance.
The diagnosis assistance method embeds a new medical case in an embedding space in which existing medical cases and experts are embedded.
The diagnosis assistance method receives a query request including a new medical case.
The diagnosis assistance method returns a subset of existing medical cases based on computed similarity with the embedded new case.
The diagnosis assistance method returns a subset of experts based on computed similarity with the embedded new case.
The diagnosis assistance method provides for the requester to select a query-for-cases query type.
The diagnosis assistance method provides for the requester to select a query-for-experts query type.
The embedding of the new medical case, existing cases, and experts is based on a medical ontology.
The system stores instructions for performing the diagnosis assistance method and includes a processor for executing them.
The computer program product stores instructions that when executed cause a computer to perform the diagnosis assistance method.
The computer processor performs at least one of the embedding, providing, returning subsets, and computing the query cost steps of the method.
The new medical case is embedded in the embedding space.
The set of existing medical cases is embedded in the embedding space.
The set of experts is embedded in the embedding space.
Multidimensional representations of existing cases, experts, and the new case are generated in the embedding space.
The requester submits a query request that includes a new medical case.<SEP>The requester submits a query request that includes the new medical case.
The new medical case comprises a plurality of records relating to a specific patient.
The new case is communicated to one of the subset of experts for diagnosis.

When the query-for-cases is selected, a subset of the cases is returned based on computed similarity between the embedded new case and the embedded existing cases.<SEP>When the query-for-cases is selected, a subset of the existing medical cases is returned based on computed similarity.

When the query-for-experts is selected, a subset of the experts is returned based on computed similarity between the embedded new case and the embedded experts.<SEP>When the query-for-experts is selected, a subset of the experts is returned based on computed similarity.
The user devices link experts with the diagnosis assistance system.
The new case is communicated to one of the subset of experts for the expert to attempt to provide a diagnosis.
The requester may select the query-for-experts query type.
The requester may select the query-for-cases query type.
The requester is provided the ability to select from a plurality of query types.
The user devices link requesters with the diagnosis assistance system.
The cost for a query-for-cases differs from the cost for a query-for-experts.<SEP>The computed query cost is lower for a query-for-cases than for a query-for-experts.
When the query-for-cases is selected, documents from a public database are returned based on computed similarity.
When the query-by-cases is selected, a query-by-experts may be performed subsequently.
The plurality of query types includes a query-for-cases.
The cost for a query-for-experts is different from the cost for a query-for-cases.<SEP>The computed query cost is higher for a query-for-experts than for a query-for-cases.
When the query-for-experts is selected, the new case is provided to a selected expert for formulating a diagnosis.
When the query-for-experts is selected, provision is made for making a payment to the expert for formulating the diagnosis.
The plurality of query types includes a query-for-experts.
The medical ontology is based on the Unified Medical Language System.
Each medical concept in the ontology corresponds to a respective dimension in the multidimensional representation.
The matrix of proximities is applied to the multidimensional representation of the new case to account for relationships between concepts in the ontology.
The processor is in communication with the memory for executing the instructions.
The diagnosis assistance system comprises a processor in communication with the memory.
The diagnosis assistance system comprises memory which stores instructions.
The network comprises a system for diagnosis assistance.
The network comprises a set of user devices for linking requesters and experts with the system.
